mapper.select:
select cast(id as char) as "key", name as "title", cast(parent_id as char) as "parentId", (case when exists ( select 1 from wms_item_category child where child.parent_id = wms_item_category.id and child.is_del = 1 ) then 0 else 1 end) as "isLeaf" from wms_item_category where is_del = 1
and parent_id = #{parentId}
and (parent_id is null or parent_id = 0)
order by sort asc, id asc
